about: birolho-legs's Personagens Média (tools/scripts/sprites/quality_copies.py, the rule of 2026-10-25): every clip of cut.json from the same matted frames, at most 64 frames picked evenly (no blend, the clip's timing kept), the figure ~610 px tall (a clip already shorter keeps its own size).
figureNote: measured 2026-11-19: the biggest circle in the figure (the ball) is 346 px in the idle video = 1.94 units (the old art's), so 1 px = 0.00560 units there and the idle's figure (878 px) is 4.918 units; every clip's figurePx is set so its own ball is as big; the hit video's hover is 0.31 ball radii over the floor it falls on
